# Owl Stitch by Mason - Knowledge Base

## About Us
Owl Stitch by Mason is a premium Indian ethnic and contemporary womenswear brand. We specialize in blending traditional craftsmanship with modern silhouettes. 
Our collections include Ethnic Wear, Party Wear, Indo-Western, and carefully curated accessories.

## Customization Services
We offer bespoke customization services for:
- Customized Dresses
- Customized Kurtis
- Custom Tailoring
- Personalized Outfits
- Custom Fashion Design

Customers can select fabrics, provide measurements, and consult with our design experts to create their perfect outfit.

## Contact Information
- **Customer Care Email:** customercare@owlstitch.com
- **Phone:** +91-816-8776809
- **Address:** 124 Luxury Ave, NY 10012
- **Website:** https://www.owlstitch.com

## Policies
- **Shipping:** Free shipping on orders over ₹10,000. Delivery typically takes 3-7 business days within India.
- **Returns:** 7-day return policy for unused, unworn items with tags intact. Custom-made items are non-refundable.
- **Exchanges:** Available within 7 days for size issues on standard garments.

## Popular Categories
- The Heritage Edit (Ethnic)
- Evening Glamour (Party Wear)
- Modern Fusion (Indo-Western)
- Clothing Edit (Western)
